basic.name: 普通攻击：猫猫爪刺
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
发动最后一段斩击时，若命中处于失衡状态下的敌人，则会重复攻击三次。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to five slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
When the final slash lands on a Stunned enemy, it repeats three additional times.

special.name: 特殊技：奇袭
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行下落打击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；
招式的追击效果增强。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
This skill's pursuit effect is enhanced.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：超~凶奇袭！
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Super Surprise Attack!
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行强力下落斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式的追击效果增强。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful falling slash, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
This skill's pursuit effect is enhanced.

fields.text:
猫又[闪避反击]或[快速支援]命中敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升60%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
猫又进入战场会获得40点[呼噜能量]，该效果在勘域模式中每180秒最多触发一次；
当猫又处于接战状态时，每秒获得1点[呼噜能量]，最多积累60点，猫又不同招式命中敌人可以回复不同量的[呼噜能量]；
猫又拥有大于等于40点[呼噜能量]时，触发[极限闪避]后点按 【闪避键】 可以消耗30点[呼噜能量]发动[闪避：尾巴失踪术]，随后点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动一次不消耗[呼噜能量]的[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]；
猫又拥有大于等于40点[呼噜能量]时，长按 【普通攻击键】 消耗40点[呼噜能量]可以发动[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]；
猫又发动[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]会进入[肉球突袭]状态，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，[肉球突袭]状态下猫又自身的攻击命中时均视为从背后命中；
处于[肉球突袭]状态时，猫又自身的攻击命中时会触发[超凶爪印]效果，造成一次等同于自身30%攻击力的物理伤害，该效果每1秒最多触发一次；
猫又发动[终结技]额外回复20点[呼噜能量]，发动[连携技]额外回复10点[呼噜能量]，发动[强化特殊技]额外回复5点[呼噜能量]。
fields.textEn:
When Nekomata's Dodge Counter or Quick Assist hits an enemy, her DMG increases by 60% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Nekomata gains 40 Purr Energy upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Nekomata is in combat, she gains 1 Purr Energy every second, up to a maximum of 60. Different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy when they hit an enemy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy and after triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Dodge] to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail. Then press [Basic Attack] to perform Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw once without consuming Purr Energy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 40 Purr Energy and activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.
When using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw, Nekomata enters the Pawpad Ambush state for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, Nekomata's attacks trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing an additional instance of Physical DMG equal to 30% of her ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Nekomata restores 20 additional Purr Energy when using her Ultimate, 10 when using her Chain Attack, and 5 when using her EX Special Attack.

fields.text:
队伍中存在[支援]角色或与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
猫又发动[闪避：尾巴失踪术]或队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[强击]效果后，猫又[强化特殊技]或[闪避反击]命中时造成的伤害提升35%，该效果最多可叠加2层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support character, or shares the same attribute or Faction:
After Nekomata uses Dodge: Disappearing Tail, or after any squad member inflicts Assault on an enemy, Nekomata's EX Special Attack and Dodge Counter deal 35% more DMG on hit. This effect stacks up to 2 times and lasts 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

fields.name: 核心被动：猫步诡影
fields.trigger: 猫又[闪避反击]或[快速支援]命中敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升60%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
fields.triggerEn: When Nekomata's Dodge Counter or Quick Assist hits an enemy, her DMG increases by 60% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
fields.description:
猫又[闪避反击]或[快速支援]命中敌人时，自身造成的伤害提升60%，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
猫又进入战场会获得40点[呼噜能量]，该效果在勘域模式中每180秒最多触发一次；
当猫又处于接战状态时，每秒获得1点[呼噜能量]，最多积累60点，猫又不同招式命中敌人可以回复不同量的[呼噜能量]；
猫又拥有大于等于40点[呼噜能量]时，触发[极限闪避]后点按 【闪避键】 可以消耗30点[呼噜能量]发动[闪避：尾巴失踪术]，随后点按 【普通攻击键】 可以发动一次不消耗[呼噜能量]的[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]；
猫又拥有大于等于40点[呼噜能量]时，长按 【普通攻击键】 消耗40点[呼噜能量]可以发动[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]；
猫又发动[闪避反击：绒爪穿刺]会进入[肉球突袭]状态，持续40秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，[肉球突袭]状态下猫又自身的攻击命中时均视为从背后命中；
处于[肉球突袭]状态时，猫又自身的攻击命中时会触发[超凶爪印]效果，造成一次等同于自身30%攻击力的物理伤害，该效果每1秒最多触发一次；
猫又发动[终结技]额外回复20点[呼噜能量]，发动[连携技]额外回复10点[呼噜能量]，发动[强化特殊技]额外回复5点[呼噜能量]。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Nekomata's Dodge Counter or Quick Assist hits an enemy, her DMG increases by 60% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Nekomata gains 40 Purr Energy upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Nekomata is in combat, she gains 1 Purr Energy every second, up to a maximum of 60. Different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy when they hit an enemy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy and after triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Dodge] to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail. Then press [Basic Attack] to perform Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw once without consuming Purr Energy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy, hold [Basic Attack] to consume 40 Purr Energy and activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.
When using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw, Nekomata enters the Pawpad Ambush state for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, Nekomata's attacks trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing an additional instance of Physical DMG equal to 30% of her ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Nekomata restores 20 additional Purr Energy when using her Ultimate, 10 when using her Chain Attack, and 5 when using her EX Special Attack.

fields.name: 额外能力：猫步秀
fields.trigger: 队伍中存在[支援]角色或与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
fields.triggerEn: When another character in your squad is a Support character, or shares the same attribute or Faction:
fields.description:
队伍中存在[支援]角色或与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
猫又发动[闪避：尾巴失踪术]或队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[强击]效果后，猫又[强化特殊技]或[闪避反击]命中时造成的伤害提升35%，该效果最多可叠加2层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
fields.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support character, or shares the same attribute or Faction:
After Nekomata uses Dodge: Disappearing Tail, or after any squad member inflicts Assault on an enemy, Nekomata's EX Special Attack and Dodge Counter deal 35% more DMG on hit. This effect stacks up to 2 times and lasts 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
